intent: Repair the live snapshot-PR cleanup without broadening deletion authority: require same-repository ownership and admit only one of two exact reserved timestamped branch grammars paired with its independently anchored lane-specific title grammar; never grant Pass 1 authority from an automation marker or broad intent phrase; preserve closed snapshot branch refs for recovery; make list and jq classification failures visible while failing closed; and bind dry-run, comment, close, and branch-cleanup summaries to the operation that actually occurred.

commit.message: fix(governance): make snapshot cleanup fail closed

interface_mismatches: The cleanup policy declared lifecycle/spine-adoption status snapshots non-mergeable, but the matcher omitted the live ops/spine-adoption-pr-lifecycle timestamp grammar.
The first repair reused broad legacy intent ORs for the new branch grammar, so a human title containing ops report could falsely authorize closure.
The second repair still allowed an automation marker plus broad snapshot language to authorize Pass 1 closure on an arbitrary same-repository branch.
Pass 1 deleted snapshot branch refs immediately even though the recovery claim relied on closed PR history.

The exact legacy chore/ops-report timestamp branch still inherited a broad ops report title matcher, so a human-looking title on that reserved branch could be closed without the lane's anchored governance grammar.
Both jq classifiers converted parser or input failures into empty-match reports, and both close loops rendered matched PRs as CLOSED before dry-run or API outcomes were known.

Classification and list failures previously produced only a failed job/log instead of a typed job-summary result; echo -e could also reinterpret backslash escapes in same-repository PR titles, and the duplicate branch-cleanup failure path lacked executable coverage.
honest_blockers: The first decorrelated council held exact head 7f8681632034d0c0f98650f9d3a0d62d6e6fc3ae on outcome-reporting defects, jq failure conflation, an overbroad legacy reserved-branch title matcher, and a vacuous fork control. A reduced-evidence council then held local exact head ed92493f14117e0731798b6069b5cef9612dcd8f because the marker fallback still admitted arbitrary branches, list/jq failures lacked typed summaries, echo -e reinterpreted title escapes, branch-cleanup failure was untested, and three required provider receipts were wrong-model or invalid JSON. This repair requires another exact-head full council and fresh current-head GitHub checks before merge.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the bounded PR. Snapshot PRs remain in closed history and their branch refs are preserved, so a mistaken closure can be reopened without reconstructing the head.
